note: Calibrated on the GitHub-hosted macos-14-arm64 runner: seed protocol count=200, samples=2, workers=2 (2026-08-28). This VM is ~10x slower than the local Apple M4 (JPG 8 vs 84 img/s) and has no ANE; the CI perf gate runs with tolerance 0.85 against these baselines. Re-calibrate (perf-calibrate workflow) if the runner image changes materially. The platforms.win32 block calibrates the windows-latest seed gate (count=120, samples=2, workers=4, 2026-08-28, 3 interleaved local runs, median-locked).

win32.note: windows-2025 runner seed protocol (4 seeds replicated count=120, workers=4, samples=2 median). Calibrated 2026-08-28 from runner run 33184724010 (JPG 7.4/7.1, HEIF 0.7/0.7, ARW 6.8/7.2, NEF 5.8/6.4 img/s across 2 samples): the 2-core shared VM is 3-10x slower than the local win32 dev box (HEIF software HEVC suffers most), mirroring the 10x macos-14 vs M4 gap. Baselines = measured median / 0.65 + ~15% headroom; gate runs with tolerance 0.65.
